title: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
title_en: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
author: Elizabeth Lopatto
content_snippet:
If the glorious AI revolution rests entirely on the well-being of one man, AI is perhaps not as robust a technology as I had previously been led to believe. Nonetheless, chunks of Silicon Valley are now insisting he is indispensable. For instance, if Elon Musk is telling the truth, then Jensen Huang (the former CEO of Nvidia, a company with a market cap of about $3 trillion) has been making deals that were “a handshake with Jensen” with suppliers — “not a written contract,” Musk wrote.

title: OpenAI says its models delivered a year's worth of chip optimization on top of AMD's own engineering

title: SoftBank regrets ‘mistake’ of not backing Anthropic, says Masayoshi Son
title_en: SoftBank regrets ‘mistake’ of not backing Anthropic, says Masayoshi Son
author: David Keohane and Madhumita Murgia
content_snippet:
SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son has said he regrets not investing in Anthropic ahead of its blockbuster initial public offering, describing it as a mistake to pass up the chance to back the AI lab because he had already started to put money into its rival OpenAI.

His comments come after OpenAI slashed its fundraising target by $10bn last month in its ongoing funding round, a deal overshadowed by an AI sell-off in the public markets and Anthropic’s plan to list this week at a target valuation of

author: Jason Parham
content_snippet:
As generational cohorts go, Gen Z has been saddled with its share of labels. They scarcely have sex, are “quiet quitters” when it comes to office jobs, and, as they avoid traditional partnership, have learned to solomaxx.

summary_en: A study by Gallup and the Digital Wellness Lab at Boston Children's Hospital surveyed 15,925 youth across 16 countries, finding 33% of Gen Z rely on AI for companionship, peaking at 50% among daily users. author: Bloomberg
content_snippet:
The malfunctions have undermined confidence in key systems used for essential tasks.

SAN FRANCISCO – Technology failures disrupting everything from Americans’ air travel and banking transactions to secretive work at the US National Security Agency are fuelling public distrust and paranoia about ageing tech infrastructure – even with no sign the episodes are linked or the work of malicious actors.

Breakdowns over the past week have caused enough havoc to spur American consumers into a panic-buy
summary_en: Recent high-profile system outages across the NSA, FAA, and Microsoft have paralyzed essential services, fueling public anxiety despite no evidence of malicious cyber-attacks. ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 近期包括美国国家安全局（NSA）、联邦航空管理局（FAA）及微软公司在内的多方关键系统相继发生技术故障，导致金融、民航及内部通信大面积瘫痪。参议员马克·沃纳指出，AI加速了系统脆弱性探测的频率，导致企业与机构在应对瞬时补丁更新时不堪重负，基础设施的韧性已无法承载当前数字化转型的极端速率。

Senator Mark Warner emphasized that AI-driven vulnerability discovery is forcing organizations to push updates at an unsustainable pace, exposing the systemic fragility of aging digital infrastructure.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】美国国家安全局（NSA）、联邦航空管理局（FAA）、微软公司、弗吉尼亚州民主党参议员马克·沃纳在美国境内关键数字化基础设施：系统性宕机导致服务中断及公众恐慌性消费，引发政界对于AI辅助攻防压力过载的关注
【起因与机理】AI驱动的自动化漏洞扫描与修复周期错位，导致基础设施在不堪重负的状态下崩塌
【核心事实细节】核心事件：跨领域关键信息系统连续多日发生不明原因故障。

fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] NSA, FAA, Microsoft, and Senator Mark Warner (US critical digital infrastructure): Widespread system outages and public panic buying triggered by concerns over infrastructure reliability
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI-accelerated vulnerability scanning forces unsustainable patch management cycles, straining legacy systems

inline_images.caption: Photo illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios. Photo: David Paul Morris/Bloomberg via Getty Images
inline_images.alt: Photo illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios. Photo: David Paul Morris/Bloomberg via Getty Images

author: Axios
content_snippet:
Nvidia's interim CEO said Tuesday that the company will be "disciplined" as it decides how much to invest in neoclouds and other AI customers going forward.

Why it matters: Nvidia isn't just the biggest chip partner for AI startups — it's a major source of capital.

What they're saying: "Our momentum is real," interim CEO Colette Kress said on at the end of conference call with investors and analysts. "Our demand is accelerating. Our supply is growing. Our customers and our partners are with us
summary_en: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress confirmed on an investor call that the company will remain 'disciplined and selective' in allocating capital to Neoclouds and other AI-centric customers. Following the resignation of Jensen Huang, the board reaffirmed its stance against his reinstatement, prioritizing leadership stability and strategic rigor in supply chain resource allocation.
title_zh: 英伟达重申对AI云服务商的投资将趋于审慎
summary_zh: 英伟达代理CEO柯莱特·克雷斯宣布公司将对Neoclouds客户保持筛选机制，以确保资本分配的纪律性

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 英伟达代理首席执行官柯莱特·克雷斯在投资者电话会上明确，公司未来在向Neoclouds及其他AI相关客户提供资本支持时将保持“纪律性与选择性”。尽管需求激增，英伟达董事会重申黄仁勋离职后公司将维持当前领导层架构，不考虑复职安排，旨在向市场传递供应链资源分配的确定性与战略稳定性。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress confirmed on an investor call that the company will remain 'disciplined and selective' in allocating capital to Neoclouds and other AI-centric customers. Following the resignation of Jensen Huang, the board reaffirmed its stance against his reinstatement, prioritizing leadership stability and strategic rigor in supply chain resource allocation.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】柯莱特·克雷斯 (英伟达代理CEO)在英伟达投资者与分析师会议：宣布对Neoclouds的支持采取审慎的资本分配政策；董事会确认不复职黄仁勋
【起因与机理】英伟达不仅是芯片供货商，也是AI初创公司主要资本来源，需在供需失衡背景下优化资产配置以维持盈利预期
【商业与财务细节】对Neoclouds客户的资本投入将执行严格的筛选机制。
【行业影响与走向】在需求加速的背景下，重点在于平衡供应链产能与资本配置的纪律性。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Colette Kress (Interim CEO, Nvidia): Announced a shift toward disciplined and selective capital support for Neoclouds; Board confirmed no reinstatement of Jensen Huang.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Nvidia functions as both a primary chip supplier and a key source of capital for AI startups, necessitating disciplined resource allocation amid extreme market demand.
[Key Fact Detail] Shift towards disciplined and selective capital allocation for Neoclouds.
[Official Stance & Demand] Strategic focus on balancing accelerating demand with disciplined asset allocation.

title: HomeView Teardown: A Surprising Step Backward
title_en: HomeView Teardown: A Surprising Step Backward

inline_images.caption: HomeView laid out on a table
inline_images.caption_en: HomeView laid out on a table

author: Carsten Frauenheim, Elizabeth Chamberlain, and Shahram Mokhtari
content_snippet:
Apple’s first iPad-stuck-to-a-HomePod smarthome hub landed on our teardown table this week, and we figured we knew what we were getting into. We’ve taken apart plenty of iPads and HomePods. And lately, Apple has actually been getting better at making them repairable.

The original HomePod took a hacksaw to open, but by the second generation, we could get inside without destroying anything. Even the notoriously glue-heavy iPad has made progress: easier battery access, replaceable USB-C ports, and
summary_en: iFixit's teardown of the Apple HomeView reveals a heavy reliance on structural adhesives for its display, speakers, and logic board, marking a regressive step in modular design. Despite recent improvements in repairability across iPad and HomePod lines, HomeView’s integration forces high-risk disassembly that frequently leads to component failure.
title_zh: 苹果HomeView拆解：维修难度大幅回升
summary_zh: iFixit拆解显示，苹果新款智能家居设备HomeView内部高度依赖强力胶粘合，维修难度远超近年推出的iPad与HomePod产品线

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 拆解分析机构iFixit对苹果智能家居中心设备HomeView进行实物测绘，发现该产品内部核心组件（显示屏、扬声器及逻辑板）大量使用工业胶粘合，而非主流的模块化螺丝结构。尽管苹果近年在iPad与HomePod系列中改善了维修便捷性，但HomeView的反向设计策略导致拆解过程中极易引发连接器受损及组件物理断裂。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: iFixit's teardown of the Apple HomeView reveals a heavy reliance on structural adhesives for its display, speakers, and logic board, marking a regressive step in modular design. Despite recent improvements in repairability across iPad and HomePod lines, HomeView’s integration forces high-risk disassembly that frequently leads to component failure.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】拆解机构iFixit；硬件厂商苹果公司(Apple Inc.)在实验室拆解环境：显示核心组件强力胶固定，维修与拆解难度极高
【起因与机理】苹果在智能家居类新型复合设备的工程设计上优先考虑了极致集成度与工业强度，放弃了近期在便携设备上体现的维修友好型策略
【核心事实细节】HomeView产品采用高强度强力胶封装，维修难度回归苹果早期水平。
【行业影响与走向】苹果在单一产品设计路径上表现出明显的维修策略退步，或影响第三方服务市场。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] iFixit; Apple Inc. (Laboratory teardown): High-strength adhesive usage prevents non-destructive access to display and logic board
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Prioritization of tight integration and structural rigidity over serviceability in the new smart home product architecture
[Key Fact Detail] HomeView uses industrial-grade adhesives, regressing on recent repairability progress.
[Key Position & Outlook] Shift in design strategy highlights potential conflict between tight hardware integration and right-to-repair standards.

title: Inside Microsoft’s giant Outlook outage
title_en: Inside Microsoft’s giant Outlook outage

inline_images.caption: Tom Warren
inline_images.alt: Tom Warren

author: Tom Warren
content_snippet:
At 9AM last Thursday, everything seemed normal. Microsoft employees were arriving on campus, ready for a regular day of emails and meetings. But barely an hour later, one of Microsoft’s worst outages in history started to unfold, leaving employees, businesses, and many governments without access to Outlook emails for nearly 24 hours.

It all started in Switzerland, according to a source familiar with the outage. Exchange Online servers that power Outlook started to fall offline. The problem quic
summary_en: Microsoft's Exchange Online service suffered a sev0-rated outage initiated by server failures in Switzerland, which triggered failover mechanisms that propagated the issue, leaving over 80% of Exchange servers unresponsive. The root cause involved a traffic surge during PXE-based reboot attempts that overwhelmed monitoring systems, forcing servers into a recursive failure loop.
title_zh: 微软Exchange服务大规模宕机始末及技术失效机制
summary_zh: 微软Exchange Online因瑞士节点故障及自动故障转移机制触发网络拥塞，导致全球80%以上服务器陷入重启循环

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 微软Exchange Online服务因瑞士服务器集群异常触发内部sev0级事故，自动故障转移机制（Failover）将流量导向非故障服务器，导致全球超80%的Exchange服务器因CPU过载陷入重启循环。微软工程团队通过内核日志排查发现，服务器在网络启动预引导环境（PXE）重连过程中遭遇瞬时流量洪峰，导致系统进入连锁性的服务恢复死锁。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Microsoft's Exchange Online service suffered a sev0-rated outage initiated by server failures in Switzerland, which triggered failover mechanisms that propagated the issue, leaving over 80% of Exchange servers unresponsive. The root cause involved a traffic surge during PXE-based reboot attempts that overwhelmed monitoring systems, forcing servers into a recursive failure loop.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】微软（Microsoft）工程团队在全球Exchange Online服务器基础设施：全球范围内超80%的Exchange服务器因自动故障转移机制导致的重启循环瘫痪近24小时
【起因与机理】瑞士区域节点异常触发自动流量转移，引发针对服务器启动及监控系统的流量拥塞
【关键数据与实测】全球超80%的Exchange服务器受影响，暴露出云服务冗余架构在极端负载下的逻辑缺陷。
【涉及范围与推进】自动故障转移机制将流量涌向健康节点，诱发服务器PXE启动阶段的重启循环。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Microsoft Engineering Teams: Over 80% of Exchange servers failed for nearly 24 hours due to a reboot loop triggered by automated failover systems.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Initial local failure in Switzerland triggered recursive traffic surges during server recovery attempts.
[Key Metrics] Over 80% of global Exchange capacity impacted, exposing architectural vulnerabilities in cloud failover logic.
[Key Position & Outlook] Automated failover systems caused recursive reboot loops by overwhelming PXE boot processes.

Hundreds of websites using the Optimizely website personalization platform served unsuspecting visitors a potent malware cocktail that targeted cryptocurrency wallets, stole payment card data, cookies, and screenshots, and delivered exploit kits for infecting iPhones and iPads, researchers said Tuesday.

ReportURI said it identified 178 websites—including CNN, Zoom, the BBC, and Salesforce—that were af

【行业影响与走向】受影响范围涉及全球百余家高权重站点，供应链防御机制存在严重合规缺口。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Exploitation of Optimizely's legitimate distribution mechanism to push malware to global audiences.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Unauthorized write access to Optimizely's customer project management systems

title: Apple services, including iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, and more, hit by outage
title_en: Apple services, including iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, and more, hit by outage
author: Sarah Perez
content_snippet:
After a recent slew of tech outages, service disruptions, and flight chaos this week, now it’s Apple customers who are facing technical issues.

On Reddit, some folks also noted that they were unable to activate a new iPhone, which is likely related to these ongoing issues.

Given the recent increase in AI-driven cyberattacks, users across social media have already begun to speculate about the cause. In particular, users are expressing concerns about the Apple outage, as it arrives only days aft
summary_en: Apple's system status page confirmed a global service outage affecting iCloud login, App Store, Apple Music, and Apple School Manager, with some users reporting failure to activate new iPhones. This incident follows closely after Microsoft's recent cloud service failure, intensifying market concerns regarding the structural vulnerability of centralized cloud architectures.

title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
title_en: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
author: Jagmeet Singh
content_snippet:
Google is extending how long it keeps temporary Gemini chats and conversations made with chat history turned off to around two months, saying the change aims to improve safety and security as AI systems become more capable.

The change, which will roll out globally in the Gemini app over the coming weeks, marks a significant increase from the previous 72-hour retention period mentioned in Google’s Gemini Apps Privacy Hub, according to an archived version from November 12.

OpenAI, by comparison,
summary_en: Google updated its Gemini Apps Privacy Hub to extend the retention period for temporary chats from 72 hours to approximately two months. The company stated this change aims to improve system safety and incident response, explicitly noting that these conversations remain excluded from AI model training. Additionally, Google decoupled chat history retention from model training permissions, allowing users to maintain logs without contributing to model development.

title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
title_en: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free

inline_images.caption: Tasks in Gemini
inline_images.alt: Tasks in Gemini

author: Emma Roth
content_snippet:
Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as “Tasks” and making it free to use. The feature, which is powered by Google’s new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, can do things like create meal plans, manage your calendar, and dig through your emails to find recurring expenses you might not need.

Google first introduced its Spark AI agent in May, but it was only available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. The launch of tasks in Gemini brings Spark’s capabilities to all users in the US, Canada, Japan
summary_en: Google rebranded its Spark AI agent to 'Tasks' and expanded its availability as a free service across the US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and India. Powered by the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, the agent operates within hardware-isolated virtual machines to perform tasks such as calendar management and email analysis. For sensitive actions involving financial transactions, the agent is programmed to halt and require explicit user authorization.

title: Roundtables: Inside the Quest for Cognitive Immortality
title_en: Roundtables: Inside the Quest for Cognitive Immortality
author: MIT Technology Review
content_snippet:
Listen to the session or watch below

In an effort to reach an elusive continuity of the self, some far-thinking technologists are working on ways to keep your brain going—even beyond death. Science editor Mary Beth Griggs and senior editor for biomedicine Antonio Regalado explore possible paths to keep your mind going, including gradual brain replacement and uploading our memories to the cloud.

Speakers: Antonio Regalado, Senior Editor, Biomedicine, and Mary Beth Griggs, Science Editor
summary_en: Antonio Regalado, Senior Editor for Biomedicine, and Mary Beth Griggs, Science Editor at MIT Technology Review, discussed pathways toward 'cognitive immortality' beyond biological death. The discourse centers on the feasibility of gradual neural replacement and the cloud-based digital migration of human memories to preserve personal consciousness continuity.
